sym:deworm.출처: 질병관리청 국가건강정보포털 — 요충증: 감염자 가족 전원 또는 단체생활 구성원 전원이 동시에 치료, 알벤다졸 400 mg 1회 · 재감염을 고려해 20일 간격 3회 이상 반복, 손 씻기·손톱·속옷·침구 관리

sym:smoking.검색제목: Quitting smoking: not on willpower alone
sym:smoking.검색설명: Explains how nicotine patches, gum, prescription medicine and support work together to help you quit.
sym:smoking.첫단락: How not to go it alone
sym:smoking.바로: Squeezing chest pain or shortness of breath

sym:hairloss.검색제목: Hair loss: minoxidil takes about four months
sym:hairloss.검색설명: Explains how to use minoxidil for thinning at the crown or hairline, how long it takes, and how alopecia areata differs.
sym:hairloss.바로: Scalp red, swollen and hot, spreading with fever and chills

sym:corn.검색제목: Corns and calluses: start with your shoes
sym:corn.검색설명: Explains easing shoe pressure, using corn treatments and when to be careful.
sym:corn.바로: Red, swollen, hot, with pus and spreading

rx:bp.검색설명: Explains what to do if you miss a dose, pharmacy medicines to be careful with, and why doses change.
찾는말: when to take blood pressure medicine
cold medicine with high blood pressure
can I stop blood pressure meds
rx:bp.첫단락: Blood pressure medicine keeps your blood pressure down while you take it. Good readings usually mean the medicine is working.
할일: Take it at the same time every day.
rx:bp.바로: If an arm or leg on one side suddenly gets weak or your speech slurs, whatever your blood pressure → call 119 now. The same goes for severe chest pain or shortness of breath.

rx:dm.검색설명: Explains handling low blood sugar, sick days and what to check before a contrast scan.
rx:dm.첫단락: Each type of diabetes medicine has its own cautions. You can tell the type from the last letters of the ingredient name on your medicine bag.
rx:dm.바로: If low blood sugar makes someone confused or unable to swallow, put nothing in their mouth → call 119 now

rx:chol.검색설명: Explains how to watch for muscle aches and liver tests on statins and why your statin may change.
rx:chol.첫단락: Cholesterol medicine is taken long-term to lower the chance of blocked blood vessels (heart attack, stroke).
할일: At the same time every day.
rx:chol.바로: Severe muscle pain and weakness with dark brown urine → emergency room today
rx:chol.출처: 미국 식품의약국 안전성 정보(2012) — 스타틴: 간 수치는 시작 전과 필요할 때 확인, 드물게 깜빡함(멈추면 돌아옴), 혈당이 조금 오를 수 있지만 심혈관 이득이 큼

rx:thy.검색설명: Explains taking it on an empty stomach, which supplements to space by 4 hours, and when to check blood tests.
rx:thy.첫단락: This medicine replaces thyroid hormone your body lacks. The dose is tiny (micrograms), so how you take it changes how well it works.
rx:thy.출처: Jonklaas 외, 미국갑상선학회 갑상선기능저하증 치료 지침, Thyroid 2014

rx:mind.검색제목: Sleeping pills, anxiety and depression medicine
rx:mind.검색설명: Explains avoiding overlapping sedatives, how to stop safely and sleep behaviors to watch for.
rx:mind.첫단락: Medicines for sleep and mood add up drowsiness when combined, and cause trouble if stopped suddenly. Following just these two points keeps most people safe.
rx:mind.바로: Shallow breathing and hard to wake → call 119 now
rx:mind.출처: Qaseem 외, 미국내과학회 만성 불면 지침, Ann Intern Med 2016 — 모든 성인에게 불면 인지행동치료를 첫 치료로(강한 권고), 약은 그 뒤에 짧게 상의해서

rx:blood.검색설명: Explains bleeding warning signs, pharmacy medicines to avoid and what to tell your doctor before procedures.
rx:blood.첫단락: These medicines prevent clots that block blood vessels (stroke, heart attack). Because bleeding may not stop easily, adding a new medicine and the time before a procedure matter most.
할일: Take it at the same time every day.
rx:blood.바로: Vomiting blood or something like coffee grounds, or stools that are black or bloody → go to the emergency room now

rx:bone.검색설명: Explains taking them on an empty stomach with a full glass of water, staying upright 30 minutes, and dental visits.
rx:bone.첫단락: This medicine slows bone loss to reduce fractures. Taking it the right way lets it be absorbed and protects your esophagus.
rx:bone.바로: If you vomit blood or have black, sticky stools → go to the emergency room now. If you're dizzy or feel faint, call 119.
rx:bone.출처: 미국골대사학회 특별위원회 — 비스포스포네이트 장기 복용 관리(Adler 2016, J Bone Miner Res): 먹는 약 5년 뒤 위험 재평가, 위험 낮으면 2~3년 쉬기 고려

rx:gi.검색설명: Explains taking them before meals, not stopping on your own, and checking yearly whether you still need them.
rx:gi.첫단락: These lower stomach acid to heal stomach ulcers and reflux, and protect the stomach while you take anti-inflammatory painkillers or blood thinners.
rx:gi.바로: If you vomit blood or have black, sticky stools → go to the emergency room now. If you're dizzy or feel faint, call 119.
rx:gi.출처: 미국소화기학회 위산 억제제 줄이기 진료 업데이트(Targownik 2022, Gastroenterology) — 1년마다 필요성 점검, 출혈 위험 높으면 유지, 끊을 때 반동 속쓰림

rx:resp.검색제목: Using an inhaler for asthma or COPD
rx:resp.검색설명: Explains daily versus rescue inhalers, correct technique and rinsing your mouth.
rx:resp.첫단락: With inhalers, technique is half the effect. There are daily inhalers, rescue inhalers for when you're short of breath, and ones that do both — check which kind you were prescribed.
rx:resp.바로: If even after the rescue inhaler you're too short of breath to finish a sentence, your lips turn blue, or you're drowsy and limp → call 119 now
rx:resp.출처: 세계천식기구(GINA) 천식 관리 전략 보고서 — 조절 흡입기 매일, 흡입 방법 확인, 응급 흡입기 사용 횟수로 조절 판단

rx:pros.검색설명: Explains getting up slowly at first, telling your eye surgeon before cataract surgery, and how long it takes to work.
rx:pros.첫단락: There are medicines that ease urine flow (-osins) and medicines that shrink the prostate (-sterides). Some people take both.
rx:pros.바로: If no urine comes out at all and your lower belly is swollen and painful → go to the emergency room now (the urine needs to be drained)
rx:pros.출처: 미국비뇨의학회 2021 진료 지침 — 전립선비대증에 따른 하부 요로 증상 1부: 첫 평가와 약물 치료

rx:gout.검색설명: Explains taking uric acid lowering medicine daily, not stopping during a flare, and stopping if a rash appears.
rx:gout.첫단락: Medicine that lowers uric acid is taken every day to prevent attacks; colchicine is used during attacks or to prevent attacks in the first few months.
rx:gout.바로: If a new rash appears after taking allopurinol → stop the medicine and contact your prescriber right away. With fever, blisters, mouth sores or face swelling → go to the emergency room now
rx:gout.출처: 미국류마티스학회(ACR) 2020 통풍 진료지침 — 급성 발작에 콜히친·NSAID·스테로이드 강한 권고, 알로퓨리놀 1차, 요산 목표 6 mg/dL 미만

rx:blad.검색설명: Explains how long it takes to work, dry mouth and constipation, and watching memory in older adults.
rx:blad.첫단락: This medicine eases urgent, frequent urination (overactive bladder). It takes a few weeks to feel the effect.
할일: Take it once a day at the same time.
rx:blad.바로: If no urine comes out at all and your lower belly is swollen and painful → go to the emergency room now

rx:ster.검색설명: Explains taking them in the morning with food, not stopping suddenly after long use, and effects on blood sugar, sleep and bones.
rx:ster.첫단락: This medicine strongly calms inflammation and the immune system. Short courses are usually safe, but after long use you need to taper it properly.
rx:ster.바로: Black stools or vomiting blood → call 119 now
rx:ster.출처: 미국류마티스학회 2022 스테로이드 골다공증 지침(Humphrey 2023, Arthritis Care Res) — 3개월 넘게 하루 2.5 mg 이상이면 시작하자마자 골절 위험 평가, 칼슘·비타민 D

rx:dem.검색설명: Explains taking it at the same time daily, early stomach upset, slow pulse and drowsy medicines to avoid.
rx:dem.첫단락: This medicine slightly slows the decline of memory. It doesn't cure, so keep taking it steadily even if you don't feel better.
할일: Take it at the same time every day.
rx:dem.바로: Fainting or passing out → call 119 now

rx:eye.검색설명: Explains using them at the same time daily, waiting 5 minutes between drops and pressing the inner corner.
찾는말: two eye drops how long apart
rx:eye.첫단락: These drops lower eye pressure to keep the optic nerve from more damage. Often you use them every day for life, even though nothing hurts.
할일: Use them at the same time every day.
rx:eye.바로: Sudden severe eye pain and redness, blurred vision, headache and vomiting → go to the emergency room now (acute glaucoma)
rx:eye.출처: 미국안과학회 원발 개방각 녹내장 진료 지침 2020(Gedde, Ophthalmology) — 안압 낮추기·정기 시야 검사·안약 넣는 법

rx:park.검색설명: Explains keeping to the schedule, not stopping suddenly, standing up slowly and watching for impulses and sleepiness.
rx:park.첫단락: These medicines replace dopamine to reduce tremor, stiffness and slowness. The effect rises and falls over time, so the time you take them matters.
할일: Take them at the set times.
rx:park.바로: High fever with severe stiffness and confusion → call 119 now

rx:pain.검색제목: Prescription pain relievers: avoid doubling up
rx:pain.검색설명: Explains avoiding overlap with pharmacy pain relievers, drowsiness, dizziness and alcohol.
rx:pain.첫단락: Prescription painkillers easily overlap with pharmacy painkillers. Avoiding overlap matters most.
rx:pain.바로: Black stools or vomiting blood → call 119 now

rx:abx.검색설명: Explains following the prescribed course, not stopping on your own, and what to avoid with each medicine.
rx:abx.첫단락: Take antibiotics for as long as your doctor set. Each medicine has different things you shouldn't take with it.
rx:abx.바로: Swelling of the lips, tongue or throat, or trouble breathing → call 119 now

rx:derm.검색제목: Oral skin medicines from the dermatologist
rx:derm.검색설명: Explains no pregnancy on isotretinoin, taking tetracyclines with water upright, and sun protection.
rx:derm.첫단락: Oral acne medicines work well but come with clear rules. Above all, isotretinoin must never overlap with pregnancy.
rx:derm.바로: If you find out you're pregnant while on isotretinoin → stop it right away and contact your prescriber today
rx:derm.출처: 미국 식품의약국 허가사항 — 이소트레티노인: 임신 금기(박스 경고)·시작 전부터 끊고 1개월까지 피임, 복용 중과 끊고 1개월 헌혈 금지, 우울·자살 생각, 뇌압 상승(테트라사이클린과 함께 피함), 비타민 A 피함

rx:herb.검색제목: Taking herbal or traditional Korean medicine
rx:herb.검색설명: Explains telling your doctor about herbal remedies, licorice and ephedra cautions, and long-term use.
rx:herb.첫단락: Pharmacy herbal granules (such as galgeun-tang [kakkonto], socheongryong-tang and jakyakgamcho-tang) and decoctions from a Korean medicine clinic are medicines too.
rx:herb.바로: Pounding heart with chest pain or shortness of breath → call 119 now
